stage0240_03:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0240_03:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0240_03:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0240_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0240_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$レディ$$
「Thanks to everyone in $c,
　the $$マリーメイア$$ Army has been successfully subdued.
　First, allow me to commend you for your hard work.」

stage0240_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Most importantly, the vice foreign ministers were unharmed.」

stage0240_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$レディ$$
「However, since we disregarded Supreme Command's wishes,
　$c will likely face
　even harsher opposition.」

stage0240_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$オットー$$
「Brigadier General $$サイガス・エイロニー$$'s faction...」

stage0240_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$レディ$$
「We will also appeal to the $$大統領$$ and their allies
　and curb the Earth supremacists as much as possible.」

stage0240_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$レディ$$
「Therefore, $c should
　ignore the noise and focus on the front lines.」

stage0240_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Understood.
　We will be counting on you, Commander.」

stage0240_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What do you intend to do
　with $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$?」

stage0240_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$レディ$$
「She was merely a puppet.
　$$デキム・バートン$$ was the mastermind behind the terror.」

stage0240_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$レディ$$
「However, considering the social ramifications,
　some form of punishment will still be necessary.」

stage0240_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$オットー$$
「Hmm... It cannot be helped.」

stage0240_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$レディ$$
「She will remain under supervision for now.
　I intend to act as her guardian.」

stage0240_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood.
　That would be the most appropriate course.」

stage0240_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Still, Neo Zeon must have been surprised.
　$$マリーメイア$$, whom they meant to use to spearhead
　their Earth invasion, declared herself its ruler.」

stage0240_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No...
　I believe $$シャア$$ anticipated even that.」

stage0240_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$...
　I know you and that man share a complicated past,
　but are you not giving him too much credit?」

stage0240_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Perhaps.
　But we must acknowledge that he is an even
　greater threat than $$マリーメイア$$.」

stage0240_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$オットー$$
「I agree.
　Commander $$ブライト$$ also feared that $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　would return to Neo Zeon above all else.」

stage0240_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$レディ$$
「As for $c's next move,
　Neo Zeon, which declared war on us,
　is surely the threat we must watch most closely.」

stage0240_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$レディ$$
「We have told Neo Zeon that someone engineered
　the tensions between Earth and the colonies,
　but they have shown no interest in a ceasefire.」

stage0240_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「These incidents may have lit the fuse,
　but war was only a matter of time...」

stage0240_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$オットー$$
「In the $$ＵＣＷ$$, Earth and the colonies were divided
　by a deep historical chasm that could not be bridged.」

stage0240_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now $$ＡＤＷ$$'s history has been added to the mix,
　and Earth supremacists and anti-Federationists
　have clashed once more...」

stage0240_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Earth Federation and Neo Zeon were supposed
　to keep that under control.
　And yet...」

stage0240_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$レディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$...
　How do you think we should proceed
　against Neo Zeon?」

stage0240_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You want me to take the helm of $c?」

stage0240_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$レディ$$
「Many members of $c
　know him only as $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$.
　If anyone can read $$シャア$$'s intentions, it is you.」

stage0240_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Investigate Neo Zeon」
「Wait and observe Neo Zeon」

stage0240_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Somewhere in my heart,
　I may still believe in $$シャア$$...」

stage0240_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He fought with us in the $$多元戦争$$,
　the $$破界事変$$, and the $$再世戦争$$.
　He must have some reason for choosing war again...」

stage0240_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$オットー$$
（$$アムロ・レイ$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　As Supreme Commander $$ブライト$$ said, their relationship
　goes beyond soldier and enemy commander...）

stage0240_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Including me, the former members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　cannot discern $$シャア$$'s true intentions.」

stage0240_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I propose that $c head into space
　and investigate Neo Zeon's movements.」

stage0240_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$レディ$$
「Then, once repairs to each unit are complete,
　$c's ships should head into space.」

stage0240_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$レディ$$
「Enemy activity within the atmosphere will be handled
　by $$ミスリル$$ and the $$プリベンター$$s,
　centered on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0240_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...
　So I will have to fight you in space once more...）

stage0240_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Do you want to settle things with me...?）

stage0240_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Somewhere in my heart,
　I may still believe in $$シャア$$...」

stage0240_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He fought with us in the $$多元戦争$$,
　the $$破界事変$$, and the $$再世戦争$$.
　He must have some reason for choosing war again...」

stage0240_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$オットー$$
（$$アムロ・レイ$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　As Supreme Commander $$ブライト$$ said, their relationship
　goes beyond soldier and enemy commander...）

stage0240_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「With $$マリーメイア$$'s forces defeated,
　Neo Zeon's invasion of Earth will be significantly
　delayed.」

stage0240_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I propose that $c observe the situation
　and remain on alert, ready to act as needed.」

stage0240_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$レディ$$
「Then, $c will return to the Far East Branch
　and prepare for emergencies while repairing each unit.」

stage0240_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Do nothing foolish, $$シャア$$...
　Do not betray our expectations.）

stage0240_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アムロ$$
（You should not be so small a man that you
　obsess over settling things with me.）

stage0240_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Private Room ～

stage0240_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
Audrey
「Please keep your voice down.
　Here, I call myself $$オードリー・バーン$$.」

stage0240_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Why are you here...?」

stage0240_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$オードリー$$
「If you mean why I am on an Earth Federation ship,
　I cannot give you a good answer myself.」

stage0240_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Perhaps the doubts within me
　have led me to simply drift with events.」

stage0240_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$オードリー$$
「If you mean why I came to this room,
　I wanted to offer you an apology.」

stage0240_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I am sorry, $$マリーメイア$$...
　While I was lost in doubt, I allowed you
　to do such a thing...」

stage0240_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Please raise your head.
　We were at fault for letting $$デキム$$ sway us.」

stage0240_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Even so, I bear responsibility
　as someone born into the Zabi family.」

stage0240_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オードリー$$
「$$マリーメイア$$... I swear to you.
　In my name, I will end the fruitless conflict
　between Earth and the colonies.」

stage0240_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I should go now.
　I can only feign entering the wrong room for so long.」

stage0240_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Still, the crew of this ship...
　the people of $c are remarkably careless.
　To think no one is even watching you.」

stage0240_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$オードリー$$
「And as I am now,
　I find their kindness comforting.」

stage0240_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Why have you not retrieved $$ジン$$?」

stage0240_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I gave $$ジン$$ a new mission
　to find the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$.」

stage0240_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...?」

stage0240_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$イズモ$$
「We have collected many $$イグラー$$s from Vega,
　but all died during dimensional transfer...
　or were altered by it.」

stage0240_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「...The first anomaly was that no female infants
　were born on this planet...」

stage0240_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Eventually, every woman died from an Unknown illness,
　leaving only men in Altair...」

stage0240_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Our purpose is not to invade Vega.
　It is simply to ensure our species survives.」

stage0240_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$イズモ$$
「We must find the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$ who can endure
　dimensional transfer, and welcome her as the true Eve.
　As the bride who will bear Altair's next generation...」

stage0240_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The strongest $$レア・イグラー$$ is most likely
　aboard the Mechanical Angel.」

stage0240_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So you see it that way too...」

stage0240_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will aid $$ジン$$ as much as I can.
　I have high hopes for that child.」

stage0240_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$イズモ$$
（$$ジン$$, I am counting on you...
　The last child born on Altair...）

stage0240_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, it appears $n and company
　will be heading into space.」

stage0240_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A battle with your former comrade, $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　My hopes of earning Z-Chips are higher than ever!」

stage0240_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the situation, so let's get fired up!
　Let's give it our all today... business, business!」

stage0240_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, it appears $n and company
　will be returning to Japan.」

stage0240_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Another fierce battle is on the horizon...
　Our hopes of acquiring Z-Chips are higher than ever!」

stage0240_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the situation, so let's get fired up!
　Let's give it our all today... business, business!」
